name: net_link_lost_while_loading_started_without
description: Two seats; client 2 has loaded and client 1 still loads when client 2's link is lost, and its new links are refused long enough for the match to start without it once client 1 has loaded (its seat AWAY in turn 0, the caretaker building for it). Its world still stands at tick 0, in loading. When a resume HELLO gets through, the match is under way: MATCH_CONFIG(rejoin) and RESYNC(rejoin) bring it to the open turn as any rejoin does, it catches up, says shown, and the seat is handed back at the next build window; the hashes agree from the checkpoint on.

steps.msg: client 2 has loaded; client 1 still loads
its link lost while the match loads, it reconnects
the match started without it: its seat AWAY in turn 0, while it still reconnects

steps.assert: rejoined and scene.client(2).resyncs[0][0] == 'rejoin' and scene.seq.rejoins == 1 and not scene.client(2).reconnecting
steps.msg: a resume HELLO got through mid-match: MATCH_CONFIG(rejoin) and RESYNC(rejoin), as any rejoin
it plays the match now, and nothing was refused

steps.eval: scene.run_until('not client(2).catching_up and client(1).sim.seat(2).state == 0 and client(2).sim.seat(2).state == 0', 6000)

steps.msg: caught up, it said shown: BACK, and the next build window handed the seat back
every hash agrees from the checkpoint on
